messages:
miguel: heads up — after merging #4589 (fused-quant-matmul) we're seeing a p95 decode regression on canaries, ~+23% vs baseline. Can someone sanity-check?
ci-bot: perf-alert: job=decode-p95 baseline=120ms current=148ms (+23%) target=canary-xg100 commit=abc123
sam: ack. which perf slices look worst? any profiler traces?
ash: (looked) saw a lot more time in a Q4 matmul kernel vs the expected q8 fused path. also memcpy spikes.
ash: profiler snippet:
```
# perf top (summarized)
AttnKernel::matmul_q4 46%
MatmulQ8Fused 5%
KVCache::serialize 7%
cudaMemcpyAsync 12%
```
nina: that pattern smells like the kernel selector is choosing the q4 fallback because of a dtype/stride mismatch. PR 4589 touched the fused-op scheduler, right?
miguel: yes — the PR reordered fusion so fused_matmul runs after attention reshape for better memory locality. small seqs may now see an implicit dtype_cast that pushes selector to the q4 path. can anyone repro locally?
ash: repro script: 
```
python tools/repro.py --model gpt-medium --seq 16 --quant q4 --batch 2 --profile
```
sam: ran the repro. with the new scheduler flag enabled p95 locally +30%. bisect points to commit abc123 as the regressor.
perf-bot: canary_hold applied: rollout=rl-2026-03-18-07 reason=perf-regression linked_commits=[abc123]
miguel: ok — hold rollout. we should revert #4589 as a quick mitigation and open a follow-up to fix the selector/scheduler interaction. can someone file a revert PR + perf ticket?
nina: I'll open the revert and create ticket PERF-789 with traces and the profiler snippet, assigning to @ash and @sam.
ash: note — KV cache shows increased serialize time in traces. my hypothesis: when fallback kernel is used we hit an extra copy/serialize path (double-serialization) before kernel; that amplifies p95 on small batches. I'll capture end-to-end traces.
mike: infra-oncall notified.
sam: proposed action list: 1) revert 2) run full canary matrix across quant modes and batch sizes 3) add unit tests for kernel selector around dtype casts 4) investigate scheduler ordering / insertion of dtype_casts and remove the implicit cast or make selector tolerant.
miguel: thanks. nina/revert + ash/sam own the followup. if anyone spots other canaries flapping, ping @here.
